runhead: U.S. History Hack · Unit 1 · Graphic Organizer Toolkit

blocks.text: Task says “compare,” “contrast,” “how are they alike/different?” for TWO things.
blocks.cite: Marzano's #1 strategy — the shared zone forces students to name what overlaps, not just list traits.

blocks.text: Learning a key term deeply — definition, characteristics, examples, non-examples.

blocks.extend: push higher-DOK — “Give a non-example that is easy to confuse with this term, and explain the difference.”

blocks.text: Whenever a standard has a Tennessee tie: link the national event to our state/community and say why the local story matters.
blocks.cite: The local-to-national move — a History Hack signature.
